Class EngineeringExternalEvidenceRecord

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.production.EngineeringExternalEvidenceRecord
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EngineeringExternalEvidenceRecord extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable receipt for a controlled decision or guarantee issued outside the simulator.
